title: Idempotency claim is dead code — case result is discarded, never gates the transition
detail: Gleam has no early return; the case value is discarded and execution falls through to find+transition unconditionally. The 'Stand down' branch logs then keeps processing — the claim gates nothing; crash-safety it claims is unrealised.
recommended_fix: Nest steps 2-4 inside the Ok(Returned(_, [_,..])) branch so the 0-row and Error branches end the function; only a freshly-claimed event should proceed to find+transition.

title: Notification entity_id is reference_call, but AC8 + dev notes require vacancy
evidence:
dispatch(
    db,
    landlord_id,
    sql.ReferenceAwaitingCorrection,
    title,
    body,
    "reference_call",
    reference_call_id,
  )
--- spec AC8 ---
> **Then** exactly ONE `reference_awaiting_correction` in-app notification row exists for the row's vacancy (entity_id = vacancy), created via `notify_reference_awaiting_correction`
detail: AC8 and dev-note 3 explicitly require entity_id = vacancy (join reference_call->application->vacancy, mirroring notify_reference_unreachable). The code dispatches entity_type='reference_call', entity_id=reference_call_id; the test asserts the same — AC8's vacancy scoping is unmet.
recommended_fix: Join to vacancy (return vacancy_id from find_reference_call_by_send_ref) and dispatch with entity_id=vacancy_id, or correct the spec/test if reference_call scoping is actually intended.

title: Missing-signature rejections log but don't capture to Sentry (AC3 requires capture)
detail: AC3 requires EVERY verification failure (including an absent signature) be captured to Sentry. The Resend missing-headers, Twilio Disabled, and Twilio missing-header branches only log_warning + reject; only a present-but-wrong signature is captured. No test asserts capture.
recommended_fix: Add a sentry_client.capture (BackgroundEvent, warning) to the three missing/unverifiable-signature branches, mirroring the wrong-signature capture; add a test asserting capture fires.

title: Spec AC1 lists 'email.complaint'; classifier handles 'email.complained'
evidence:
> **When** a svix-verified `email.bounced` / `email.complaint` / delivery-failure event arrives for a referee contact on a live (`queued`/`contact_initiated`) row
--- classifier ---
    "email.complained" -> "email_complaint"
detail: The spec (AC1) and the classifier use different Resend event names ('email.complaint' vs 'email.complained'). If Resend emits the spec's form, complaints will not trigger the correction path. Confirm the real Resend event name.
recommended_fix: Verify Resend's actual complaint event name against vendor docs and align the classifier and spec; add a test asserting the real event name maps to a reason.
